import ctypes

# Load the libraries in the correct order
ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so', mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
gsl = ctypes.CDLL('/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so')

# Define the gsl_message function prototype
# void gsl_message(const char * reason, const char * file, int line, unsigned int mask)
gsl.gsl_message.argtypes = [ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_char_p, ctypes.c_int, ctypes.c_uint]
gsl.gsl_message.restype = None

# Function to call gsl_message
def call_gsl_message(reason, file, line, mask):
    reason_bytes = reason.encode('utf-8')
    file_bytes = file.encode('utf-8')
    gsl.gsl_message(reason_bytes, file_bytes, line, mask)

# Test cases

def assert_test():
    # Test with a mask that should print the message
    call_gsl_message('Test reason', 'test_file.c', 42, 1)
    # Test with a mask that should not print the message
    call_gsl_message('Test reason', 'test_file.c', 42, 0)
    # Test with different line numbers
    call_gsl_message('Another reason', 'another_file.c', 100, 1)
    # Test with different file names
    call_gsl_message('Reason', 'file.c', 10, 1)

if __name__ == '__main__':
    assert_test()
